title: Achilng/floral-notepaper
claim: Achilng/floral-notepaper — 花笺，轻量优雅的跨平台桌面便签工具，支持 Markdown 编辑与预览
why_good: The combination of lightweight design and Markdown support caters to a niche market of users who prefer minimalistic productivity tools.
value: Freemium model targeting individual users and teams, with premium features for enhanced collaboration and cloud storage options.
risk: The market is saturated with established note-taking apps, making user acquisition difficult against well-funded incumbents.
